newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares slide in lighter trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares slide in lighter trade.

text.p: Estonian shares slid in lighter trade on Friday as investors remained on the sidelines, dealers said.
The Tallinn stock exchange index fell by 0.40 percent to close at 186.36 on a turnover of 25.2 million kroons versus 34.3 million kroons on Thursday.
Market leader Hansapank was the most active share in trade of 10.7 million kroons and it firmed to 176.30 kroons from 176.25 kroons.
Tallinna Pank continued to slide, falling to 62.00 kroons from 62.45 kroons in trade of 6.4 million kroons.
Dealers said that orders were down as investors consider their positions and options.
In other stocks, Forex Pank dropped to 147.50 kroons from 149.75 kroons in trade of almsot 3.2 million kroons.
The over-the-counter market turned over 7.5 million kroons on Friday.
